name: soporte-respuesta-incidentes
title: Support + incident response (runbook pending)

evidence.rationale: 5-case support playbook: binary not start / capture lost / MCP timeout / schema migration fail / OOM kill; each with §signal → §diagnosis → §mitigation → §escalation
ADR formalises alert thresholds + runbook cross-references (per ADR-0004: every alert has a runbook entry)
8 metrics (health.status, events_lost_rate, mcp_tool_latency_p99, process_rss, oom_kills, disk_free_bytes, redb_writer_queue_full) with runbook cross-references

gaps: Playbook covers 5 cases (80/20 per ADR-0033 §2.1); exhaustive coverage is out of scope by design (cases outside get investigation + new entries)
cert_relevance: CERT-3 (pass: 5-case playbook + alert thresholds + cross-references defined; exhaustive coverage deferred per ADR-0033 §2.1)
